short: zaf Rust crate, the framework's verb binary
is: The Rust crate for zaf, the single project-blind binary of Zuri's AI Framework whose verbs the teams plugin drives over a board, a VCS, a forge, a design source, runners and a gate.
conventions: Built with cargo from inside zaf/ (edition 2024, publish = false); Cargo.lock is committed and CI builds with --locked
The gate is cargo fmt --check, build, clippy --all-targets -D warnings, test; any clippy warning fails it
Cargo.toml's version must equal the release tag zaf-v<version>

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: crate manifest: lib plus the zaf bin

fs.name: assets/
fs.role: prompts, briefs and profile settings compiled into the binary

fs.name: tests/
fs.role: integration tests on the built binary

notes: The gate commands live in the repo-root ZAF.toml [gate] (full, light, tests), each `cd zaf && cargo ...`
The design spec is docs/zuri-ai-framework.md (§7.4 for the ports-and-adapters layout); the crate has no README of its own
Dependencies are only clap, serde, toml, serde_json, thiserror, derive_more, strum, semver and humantime; every backend is reached by shelling out
